latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of SaaS Marketing Playbook.

- Provides comprehensive SaaS marketing strategies for B2B and B2C, including content marketing, SEO, paid acquisition, product-led growth, and customer success.
- Features real-world case studies from HeyGen, Deel, Vercel, and Supabase.
- Includes details on SaaS pricing, packaging, and retention tactics.
- Redirects users to the full playbook at Gingiris B2B Growth Playbook.
